stall	The negotiations <b>stalled</b> after the first meeting.	The negotiations <span class="lacuna">_____</span> after the first meeting.	(verbo) travar, emperrar	to stop making progress	"the car stalled" = o carro morreu	y	whatsapp trabalho
done	It is <b>done</b>.	It is <span class="lacuna">_____</span>.	(adjetivo) pronto	finished		y	whatsapp
give up	He <b>gave up</b> smoking last year.	He <span class="lacuna">_____</span> smoking last year.	(phrasal verb) desistir	to stop trying		y	whatsapp phrasal_verb
